proof_boundaries: CM theorem applies at good primes p >= 5; p = 3 is a separate finite check.
One-curve supersingularity is not Ogg all-j rationality.
Class-number and all-j censuses remain within their stated finite ranges.
Fourier boundary sums converge by Dirichlet and use a finite outer sum; no modularity theorem follows.
Bolza twist preserves geometric CM and zero trace, not rational trace or planar-Jacobian hypotheses.
The arithmetic nature of C and a modular formula for D remain open.
Intervals use an audited analytic remainder and directed arithmetic, not a formal proof kernel.
